## Background and Career Overview {#chap-resume-career}

### Doctorate degree and post-doctorate {#chap-resume-career-PhD}

I have defended [my PhD](/publications/thesis/folio2007thesis.qmd) in Robotics in 2007 within the Robotics, Action, and
Perception (<abbr lang="en" title="Robotics, Action, and Perception">RAP</abbr>)
group of the Laboratory for Analysis and Architecture of Systems[^laas] 
(<abbr lang="en" title="Laboratory for Analysis and Architecture of Systems">LAAS</abbr>), 
<abbr lang="fr" title="Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique">CNRS</abbr>[^cnrs], 
under the supervision of Viviane Cadenat,
Associate Professor at the Paul Sabatier University of Toulouse, France.
Specifically, my PhD thesis was entitled 
["*Multi-sensor-based control strategies and visual signal loss management for mobile robots navigation*"](/publications/thesis/folio2007thesis.qmd#sec-details) [@folio2007thesis].
My thesis subject was to design multi-sensor-based control strategies allowing a mobile
robot to perform vision-based tasks amidst possibly occluding obstacles. Indeed,
the improvement of sensors gave rise to the sensor-based control which allows
defining the robotic task in the sensor space rather than in the configuration
space.
\
In addition, during my doctorate degree, I also had the opportunity to perform
teaching activities, first as temporary teacher (3 years), and then as teaching
assistant, specifically in French as ["Attaché Temporaire d'Enseignement et de Recherche"]{.french lang="fr"}
(<abbr lang="fr" title="Attaché Temporaire d'Enseignement de Recherche">ATER</abbr>, 1 year),
both for the Paul Sabatier University of Toulouse. These global teaching
experiences have led to a total volume of 308 hETD[^hETD].

Between 2007 and 2008, I joined the Lagadic team at [<abbr lang="en" title="Institut national de recherche en informatique et en automatique">Inria</abbr>](https://www.inria.fr/centre/rennes)[^Inria]
Rennes-Bretagne Atlantique as a post-doctoral fellow on sensory control
for unmanned aerial vehicles. My postdoctoral fellow has been supported
by _Sensory Control for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles_
(<abbr lang="en" title="Sensory Control for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles">SCUAV</abbr>) {{< var ANR >}} project[^ANR].
The main objective was to improve multi-sensor-based servoing tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles. The idea was to design
robust control law that combine different sensory data directly at the
control level. Especially, I have contributed to the design of a new
online sensor self-calibration based on the sensor/robot interaction links [@kermorgant2010icra].


### Tenured as associate professor {#resume-career-tenure}


In 2008, I was hired as Associate Professor for the {{< var CNU61 >}} at the
(<abbr lang="fr" title="École Nationale Supérieur d'Ingénieurs">ENSI</abbr>)
of Bourges, which has been the {{< var INSA-CVL >}} since 2014.
Since my  appointment, I have been regularly involved in the life of the Institute. At the local level, I contribute 
to the scientific animation (e.g. organizing laboratory visits) and 
the relationship between education and research. For instance, I regularly participate in the
International Relations Division by accompanying the various
delegations of school and university partners during their visits. In March
2017, the direction of the {{< var INSA-CVL >}} gave me the mission of referent on _racism and antisemitism_.

As a [lecturer](/teaching/index.qmd), I am involved, among others, in developing of
electronics and electrical sciences [teaching activities](/teaching/index.qmd) within the Institute. 
Since becoming an associate professor, my average teaching load has been about 270 hETD per year. \
In addition, I have been entrusted with various responsibilities that have influenced my teaching duties. 
Since September 2014, I have been in charge of the [_Nuclear Energy_](/teaching/SFEN.qmd) option for the 5^th^ year  (engineer's degree, M2) of the {{< var MRI >}} Department. 
Between  2017 and 2020, I was elected member of the Council of the {{< var ERE >}} Department.
Since November 2020, I have been an elected member of the Department Council of the {{< var MRI >}}, and was re-elected in November 2023.
Additionally, since May 2023, I am an elected member of the Graduate Studies Council of the {{< var INSA-CVL >}}.

Furthermore, I carry out my [research activity](/research/index.qmd) with the {{< var PRISME-Laboratory >}}[^PRISME]
in the {{< var axe-robotique >}} belonging to the Images, Robotics, Automatic control and Signal 
({{< var IRAuS >}}) Department. 
Since I have been an associate professor, my
field of scientific research mainly focused on the 
_modeling and control for [nano and micro-robots](/research/microrobotics/index.qmd) in a 
[biomedical](/research/microrobotics/biomedical/index.qmd) context_. 
Globally, my main contributions focus on the study of [**magnetic microrobots**](/research/microrobotics/magnetic-microrobot/index.qmd) for [medical applications](/research/microrobotics/biomedical/index.qmd).
\
Meanwhile, I have also contributed to the development of
micromanipulation activities of the laboratory [@kim2011icra; @kim2012tase; @2013amariISOT;@2013amariIROS;@2014amariECC; @2014amariIJO; @2016amariEnclyclopedia].

On December 3, 2021, I defended [my Habilitation](/publications/thesis/folio2021hdr.qmd) (in French "[Habilitation à Diriger la Recherche](/publications/thesis/folio2021hdr.qmd){lang="fr" .fr}" -- HDR), entitled 
["_Magnetic Microrobotics for Biomedical Applications_"](/publications/thesis/folio2021hdr.qmd#sec-details) [@folio2021hdr].

Since November 2023, I am a full member appointed to the [61^st^ Section of the <abbr lang="fr" title='Conseil National des Universités'>CNU</abbr>](/research/cnu61/index.qmd){lang=fr}

[^laas]: <abbr lang="en" title="Laboratory for Analysis and Architecture of Systems">LAAS</abbr> is a laboratory depending on the <abbr lang="fr" title="Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique">CNRS</abbr>, <http://www.laas.fr>

[^cnrs]: <abbr lang="fr" title="Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique">CNRS</abbr> is the French National Center for Scientific Research. <http://www.cnrs.fr>

[^hETD]: Equivalent TD hours,  or [heures équivalentes TD]{.french lang="fr" custom-style="French"}
         (hETD) in French, are the reference hours used to calculate the teaching duties. 

[^Inria]: From French: [Institut national de recherche en informatique et en automatique]{.french lang="fr" custom-style="French"}. <https://www.inria.fr/centre/rennes>

[^ANR]: From French ["Agence Nationale de la Recherche"]{.french lang="fr" custom-style="French"} ({{< var ANR >}}), which is the French National Research Agency. <http://www.agence-nationale-recherche.fr>

[^CNU]: From French ["Conseil National des Université"]{.french lang="fr" custom-style="French"} ({{< var CNU >}}), comprises 57 sections covering different scientific disciplines. The 61^st^ section involves automation, IT engineering, robotics and signal processing. <https://www.conseil-national-des-universites.fr>

[^PRISME]: {{< var PRISME-Laboratory >}} is from University of Orléans and from {{< var INSA-CVL >}} (EA 4229). <http://www.univ-orleans.fr/prisme>
